issues.reason: The Time section states that an event-noun's witness IS the eventuality ("the ceremony occurred" reifies no `occur` event), so `sk_discussion_1` already IS the complement eventuality and `(Theme sk_hope_1 sk_discussion_1)` is the control pattern's `Theme` link; "have a discussion" is the reviewer's own uncovered support-verb gap, where the literal routing ("have + NP alone is possession") would assert the false claim that we possess a discussion.

Same ground: `sk_discussion_1` is an event-noun witness, i.e. an eventuality, not a bare entity, and `(Agent sk_discussion_1 sk_group_1)` is true (we would hold the discussion) and carries no status atom, exactly as the control rule requires of a complement event that asserts nothing about occurrence.

`BeforeBy` is the exact measured gap ("resigned three days ago"), so the atom asserts the discussion falls exactly five months from now, whereas "within the next three to five months" states only an upper bound over a range — more than the text says.

`(Ordinal <entity> <n> <scale>)`'s third slot is an ordering scale — the associated event or an "-est" dimension ("the first to respond" -> `(Ordinal priya 1 respond)`) — not the set the entity is drawn from, so a group witness there is ill-typed.

gaps_confirmed: relative deadline "within the next N months" — no bounded-gap form beside the exact `BeforeBy`, and no way to place a calendar bound without TODAY
numeric range ("three to five months") — no licensed two-endpoint quantity
light / support verb "have a discussion" over an event-noun — the collapse is scoped to occur / happen / take place, and "have + NP" alone is routed to possession
new_gaps: a sentence that is the tail of a direct quotation (a closing quote mark, no reporting clause in the item) — nothing specifies whether to seal it under a reporting attitude or assert it directly
repair_summary: Replaced the exact-gap `(BeforeBy now sk_discussion_1 5 month)` with the entailed, licensed ordering `(Before now sk_discussion_1)` — no bounded-gap form exists, so the over-asserted magnitude is dropped and the gap recorded. Corrected `Ordinal`'s scale slot from the superset group to the associated event class: `(Ordinal sk_discussion_1 1 discussion)`.
notes: The reviewer's fourth gap does not stand: `Ordinal`'s scale slot admits "the associated event", which `discussion` supplies, and `(PartOf sk_discussion_1 sk_discussions_1)` already carries the "of these" restriction.
